groups.sentence: Instructors ensure student work focuses on their own interpretation and critical analysis of AI results.
Instructors may define in course policies which AI data analysis uses are permitted.
Students may use generative AI to analyze data, find patterns and draw insights from it.
Everyone may use AI for data analysis, pattern recognition and visualization in research and coursework.
Students may use AI for calculations and spreadsheet manipulation only as specified in assignments.
AI use for data analysis is permitted only with oversight and under transparency policies.
Everyone uses extreme caution when using AI tools to analyze data.
Students must not use AI to analyze data, draw conclusions or interpret simulation results in graded work.
AI advances research capabilities by automating data analysis.
